$schema_note: Language-neutral rules authority for Cocky Monk, generated from PRD §5.3 (scoring), §5.4 (length & fairness) and §5.5 (edge cases). Drives Lab/js/engine.test.mjs (node --test) now and Tests/EngineTests (Swift Testing) on Mac day. The Lab and the demo are NOT rules authorities — this file is. Player index 0 in each round vector is that round's GM. Options of kind 'truth' have no authors; 'decoy' options are authored by the GM; voters never see options they authored (E5) and the GM never votes (E6).

decisions.note: Merged identical bluffs (PRD §5.5): each author scores ceil(votes/authorCount); for the Gullnese bluffVotes tally each author is credited the option's full vote count.
Win threshold: score >= target, checked only when round % playerCount == 0 (demo line 807 behavior, canonical per PRD §5.4 'full rotation').
Dobbeltreff authors are removed from the option pool (their bluff merges with truth), receive +3, and still vote; the truth option remains votable by them (truth has no authors).

Phase timeouts (PRD §5.2a) are per round, never permanent. A player who misses the bluff or vote window keeps their score, stays in playerCount and the GM rotation, and is expected again after the next drawCard — deliberately NOT the `dropped` path of PRD §5.5. Missing a bluff does not forfeit the vote, and vice versa. Their missing answer or vote is simply absent, which scoreRound already handles, so no scoring rule changes: R8 lands on the same pool as the drop vector R7, and R9 flips gmStole purely by absence.

rounds.desc: PRD §5.3 rows 1-2: +2 truth voter, +1 per vote to lie authors (incl. GM decoy).
PRD §5.3 row 3: nobody voted the truth → GM +2, on top of GM decoy votes.
PRD §5.3 row 4 + D3: Bo's bluff ≈ truth → +3, merged out of the pool; Bo may still vote the truth.
PRD §5.5 + D1: Anne and Cam wrote identical bluffs → one merged option, points split rounding up for each.
PRD §5.5: 3 players → 2 bluffs + truth + up to 2 GM decoys; truth found → no steal.
GM earns per decoy vote AND the steal when nobody finds the truth (PRD §5.3: GM earns only via decoys + steal).
PRD §5.5: a bluffer drops mid-round → their pending bluff and vote are skipped; scoring proceeds with the rest.

PRD §5.2a: Cam missed the 60 s bluff window, so his answer never entered the pool — but he is NOT dropped, so he still votes and still scores from it. Same option pool as a drop (R7), reached by a different route.
PRD §5.2a: Anne was the only one who would have found the truth, but missed the 45 s vote window. Her vote is simply absent, so nobody found the truth and the GM steals the round (§5.3 row 3).

games.desc: PRD §5.4 + D2: crossing the target mid-rotation does not win; the check fires only when the rotation completes.
PRD §5.4: tie past the line at rotation end → omkamp (sudden death); tied players bluff, next-highest scorer acts as GM.
PRD §5.4: omkamp resolves nothing → shared victory, shared confetti.

behaviors.desc: PRD §5.5: empty/whitespace bluff is blocked; state unchanged, playful nudge signalled.
PRD §5.5: the shuffle may never fire before the GM decoy state is settled, even with all bluffs in.
PRD §5.5: GM drops → role passes to the next player, round restarts with a fresh card.
PRD §5.2#4: a voter's own option never appears in their vote list; truth (no authors) is visible to all bluffers.
PRD §5.1: the game master never votes.
PRD §5.1: GM rotates every round in setup order, wrapping around.
PRD §5.2a: once the bluff window has closed for a seat, a late submission is rejected. Without this the answer could slip in after the pool was settled and appear from nowhere mid-vote.
PRD §5.2a + §5.5 decoy gating: the GM's decoy window closing settles the decoy state exactly like a manual done — a partial draft is kept, not discarded, and the vote may then open.
